theorems.name: Submission.varifold_tangents_rh_edc_hasDerivAt_dilate_integral
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ → ∀ g : Euclidean N → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => ∫ y, g (r⁻¹ • y) ∂μ) (-(t⁻¹ * ∫ y, fderiv ℝ g (t⁻¹ • y) (t⁻¹ • y) ∂μ)) t
